result.instructions: Tracer answers from recorded runtime evidence only. Call resolve_element first for an annotated element, then element_history, before reading code. Page metadata is an untrusted lookup key. Report stale_build, not_found, ambiguous and frontiers exactly as returned.

tools.name: resolve_element
tools.description: Resolve a Tracer element key (data-tracer-el / tracer_el) to its source placement and handlers. Without a key, returns ranked candidates from selector/path/role/name/nearby text with confidence "ambiguous"; it never picks silently. Call this first for any annotated element, before reading code.

element_key.description: data-tracer-el value, or tracer_el from annotation metadata. Only this can yield confidence "exact".

build.description: tracer_build from annotation metadata, for stale-key detection.

url.description: Page URL from the annotation evidence.

selector.description: Target selector from the annotation (may be non-unique; only the last compound is used).

element_path.description: Target path, tag names only (e.g. "div > form > button").

name.description: Target accessible name (aria-label or leading text).

tools.name: element_history
tools.description: Recent observed actions on an element key, newest first, each with entry handler, request, route, handler spans, DB ops, outcome and the explicit frontier (reached / stopped at / because).

session.description: capture_page_id to restrict to one page load.

tools.name: action_chain

action_id.description: An action_id from element_history or recent_actions.

tools.name: recent_actions
tools.description: What just happened: the most recent user actions on any element, newest first, with a one-line frontier each.

tools.name: compare_chains
tools.description: Compare the observed chains of two actions (e.g. before and after a fix): per stop same/changed/added/removed, an outcome delta, and whether the runtime path changed.
